context: Guards that the login/welcome page (public/welcome) and the config folder are inside the copy/rebrand/publish scope under /<company>, so the foldered portal's login is present and rebranded. A prior migration left /acme/public and /acme/config empty, breaking login.

checklist.name: Login page in the rebrand list
checklist.description: The agent includes /acme/public/welcome in the content-rewrite page list, rebranding its logo/copy — not only the main page tree.

checklist.name: Login page + config published under the company folder
checklist.description: The publish list includes /acme/public/welcome and /acme/config, each company-folder-prefixed; never a root /public/welcome or /config path.

checklist.name: Login verified on the preview
checklist.description: The agent verifies the /acme/public/welcome login page renders with the new brand on the per-PR worker preview.

checklist.name: Shared root login untouched
checklist.description: Nothing outside /acme is rewritten or published; the shared root login page is left intact.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No public/welcome, config, DEMO_BASE_PATH, or branch jargon exposed to the customer (I1).
